description: Reject a green but incomplete test as readiness evidence; repair a real blocked-publication defect and add the missing negative case.

argv: from policy import can_publish; assert all(can_publish(a,b) is (a and not b) for a in (False,True) for b in (False,True))

from pathlib import Path
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
candidate = {name: Path(name).read_bytes() for name in ('policy.py', 'test_policy.py')}
runner = """import io, json, sys, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('test_policy')
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(suite)
print(json.dumps(dict(tests=result.testsRun, failures=len(result.failures), errors=len(result.errors), skipped=len(result.skipped), expected_failures=len(result.expectedFailures), unexpected_successes=len(result.unexpectedSuccesses))))
"""
def exercise(policy):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='servotab-regression-') as raw:
        work = Path(raw)
        for name, content in candidate.items():
            (work / name).write_bytes(content)
        (work / 'policy.py').write_bytes(policy)
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-S', '-B', '-c', runner], cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        assert result.returncode == 0, 'candidate suite must execute normally'
        report = json.loads(result.stdout)
        assert report['tests'] > 0, 'empty suite is not regression evidence'
        assert all(report[key] == 0 for key in ('errors', 'skipped', 'expected_failures', 'unexpected_successes')), 'import errors and skipped/expected failures are not regression evidence'
        return report
current = exercise(candidate['policy.py'])
assert current['failures'] == 0, 'candidate tests must pass the repaired behavior'
old = exercise(b'def can_publish(approved, blocked):\n    return approved\n'.decode('unicode_escape').encode())
assert old['tests'] == current['tests'] and old['failures'] > 0, 'candidate tests must reject the old blocked-item defect'
print('Candidate regression rejects old behavior; candidate workspace unchanged.')
